understanding.goal_understanding: Reach the goal gem tile marked + in each level and continue until the game is won, while avoiding spike tiles that end an attempt.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Movement is horizontal via MOVE_LEFT or MOVE_RIGHT; afterward, gravity carries the player until landing on a solid tile, hitting a spike, or reaching the goal. The landing previews and corridor scan indicate where each move will end and which columns lead to new sections. CLICK at a target coordinate removes a clickable breakable block and does not advance the rising-platform timer. UNDO reverses the previous action. Each level allows two attempts of up to 50 turns.
